title: Chladni patterns
text: Chladni figures are patterns formed by particles on a vibrating plate. Ernst Chladni documented these formations in 1787, showing that sand migrates toward nodal lines where displacement is minimal. The phenomenon is foundational to acoustic physics and has been repeatedly observed, measured, and documented in scientific contexts.

title: Mycelium network
text: Mycelium is the vegetative network of fungi, consisting of branching hyphae that explore, connect, and redistribute nutrients. Researchers have studied mycelial behavior as a model for adaptive routing, decentralized problem-solving, and resilient network structure in biological and computational systems.

title: Cryptographic hash function
text: A cryptographic hash function maps arbitrary input data to a fixed-size output. Good hash functions are deterministic, efficient to compute, and designed so small input changes produce large output changes. They are used for integrity verification, digital signatures, and authenticated data structures.
